name: Candle Business Spreadsheet
title: Candle Business Spreadsheet: Candle Cost Calculator, Pricing, Pour Planner, Inventory & Sales Tracker
etsy_title: Candle Business Spreadsheet, Candle Cost Calculator, Candle Pricing Template, Fragrance Load, Inventory & Sales Tracker, Excel Google Sheets
description:
Cost every candle to the cent, price it for wholesale and retail, and know exactly how much wax and fragrance to weigh out.

WHAT YOU GET
• Supplies library: wax, fragrance oils, wicks, vessels, lids, labels and boxes; cost per ounce or piece is worked out for you
• Candle costing: pick the vessel, wax, fragrance and wick, type the fill weight and fragrance load %, get the true cost
• Wholesale and retail prices from your own mark-ups, plus an Etsy fee estimate and profit per sale
• Pour planner: choose a candle and a batch size to get wax and fragrance in ounces and grams, with a stock check
• Stock levels with reorder alerts so you never run out of your best-selling scent
• Sales log and dashboard: sales, profit and units by month, by channel (Etsy, markets, wholesale) and by candle

INSIDE
Start Here guide, Dashboard, Settings, Supplies & stock (100 rows), Candle Costing (40 candles), Pour Planner, Sales (500 rows).

FILES
1 Excel file (.xlsx) that also works in Google Sheets (File > Import, or upload to Google Drive and open with Google Sheets). Works with Numbers on Mac with basic formatting.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Buy and download instantly from your Etsy Purchases page.
2. Open in Excel, or upload to Google Drive and open with Google Sheets.
3. Type your numbers in the yellow cells. Everything in green is calculated for you.

PLEASE NOTE
This is a DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. Colours may look slightly different on screen and in print.
For use in your own business. Please don't share or resell the file.
Designed by our small studio with the help of digital and AI tools; every page and formula was planned, checked and tested by us.

Questions? Send us a message, we're happy to help.

45 cosy Scandinavian folk-style Christmas elements and 6 seamless patterns in one warm, matching palette.

• Editable SVG vector files: scale to any size and recolour in Cricut, Silhouette, Inkscape or Illustrator

etsy_title: December Daily Journal Kit Printable, 25 Days of Christmas Journaling Cards, Advent Memory Keeping, Scrapbook Ephemera, Digital Download
description:
Capture every day of December: one prompt card a day, plus number circles, papers and ephemera in a cosy Nordic folk style.

WHAT YOU GET
• 25 numbered daily prompt cards (4 x 3 in) from 'How December began' to 'Christmas Day', plus 5 bonus cards
• 25 number circles to stick onto photos or pages

• One-line-a-day '25 Days of December' page, Dear Santa letter and 4 list cards (gifts, cards sent, bucket list, baking)
• Tickets, gift tags and word labels to cut out and layer
• 6 full-page patterned papers that match the cards

INSIDE
Cover & tips, 30 prompt cards, Number circles, 12 journaling cards, One-line-a-day page, List cards, Ephemera page, Dear Santa letter, 6 papers.

FILES
2 PDF files: US Letter (8.5 x 11 in) and A4. Cards print at their true size (4 x 3 in and 3 x 4 in).
